info.name: Sharing Vision — Article API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Sharing Vision backend test (Post Article use case).

Endpoints follow the spec exactly: /article/ (POST), /article/{limit}/{offset} (GET), /article/{id} (GET), /article/{id} (PUT/PATCH), /article/{id} (DELETE).

The public deployment is https://sv.farrel.moe — set the `baseUrl` collection variable when testing locally (e.g. http://localhost:8080).

Validation (spec §4): Title >= 20 chars, Content >= 200 chars, Category >= 3 chars, Status required (publish|draft|thrash). Validation failures return HTTP 422.

Self-grading: every request ships a Postman `tests` script that asserts the expected status code, headers (X-Total-Count), and body shape — including a soft-delete re-check and a 422 validation demo. Run the collection top-to-bottom in order: request 1 creates the article and stamps the `articleId` collection variable used by requests 3–5. All assertions pass against the public deployment at https://sv.farrel.moe.

item.name: 1. Create article

request.description: Creates a new article. Validates: title >= 20, content >= 200, category >= 3, status in {publish, draft, thrash}. Returns 201 with the stored article.

item.name: 2. List articles (limit/offset pagination)

request.description: Displays all articles with pagination via the {limit}/{offset} path parameters (spec §3 row 2). Response body is a JSON array; the total row count is in the X-Total-Count response header. Append ?status=publish|draft|thrash to filter.

item.name: 3. Get article by id

request.description: Displays the article corresponding to the requested id (spec §3 row 3). Returns 404 when the id does not exist.

item.name: 4. Update article by id

request.description: Modifies the article for the requested id (spec §3 row 4). PUT and PATCH are both accepted. Same validation rules as create; failures return 422.

item.name: 5. Delete article by id

request.description: Deletes the article for the requested id (spec §3 row 5). Implemented as a soft delete: the row's Status flips to "thrash" and remains in the database. Returns 204.

item.name: 6. Create article — validation failure demo (422)

request.description: Demonstrates spec §4 validation: title < 20, content < 200, category < 3 and an invalid status each produce HTTP 422 with an {"error": "..."} envelope.
